mentions.name: Self-built print server
mentions.description: A print server built from scratch because no commercially available print server existed; creating it led to deep involvement with the Linux printing stack.
mentions.problem: Nobody made a commercially available print server.
mentions.source_excerpt: Nah, I got into printing because nobody made a commercially available print server, and I ended up making my own, with all the involvement in the stack in the process.
